name: TIP (PACLitaxel / Ifosfamide / CISplatin, with mesna)

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: The cytotoxic TIP backbone is not biomarker-restricted. HPV/p16 status is prognostic in penile squamous cell carcinoma but is not a dose gate. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Penile Cancer, Principles of Systemic Therapy (PN-D).

premedications.name: PACLitaxel premedication
premedications.notes: Corticosteroid, H1 and H2 antihistamine premedication before paclitaxel (hypersensitivity prophylaxis).

premedications.name: Mesna (uroprotection)
premedications.notes: Mandatory with ifosfamide to prevent hemorrhagic cystitis; dose per institutional ifosfamide order set (source does not state a numeric mesna dose).

premedications.name: Hydration
premedications.notes: IV pre- and post-hydration with CISplatin; supports mesna uroprotection.

supportiveCare: Uroprotection: mesna with every ifosfamide dose; monitor urine for hematuria (hemorrhagic cystitis).
Neurologic: monitor for ifosfamide encephalopathy (confusion, somnolence).
Nephroprotection: IV hydration and electrolyte repletion with each CISplatin dose.
Antiemetics: CISplatin-containing multiday regimen; prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier. Confirm exact institutional/guideline tier.
G-CSF: consider per febrile-neutropenia risk assessment for this three-drug regimen.
monitoring: Renal function (creatinine/GFR) and electrolytes (Mg, K, Na) before each cycle - CISplatin
Ototoxicity and peripheral neuropathy assessment - CISplatin / PACLitaxel
Restage inguinal/pelvic nodes to assess response before consolidative surgery

doseModificationRules.text: Hold ifosfamide and obtain clinical review; consider methylene blue per institutional protocol. Physician decides.
Increase hydration and mesna, hold ifosfamide, review. Physician decides.

doseModificationRules.condition: rising creatinine / falling GFR, ototoxicity, or grade 2+ neuropathy
doseModificationRules.text: Review required; consider dose reduction or delay. Physician decides.

drugs.name: PACLitaxel
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v2.2026, PN-D 4 of 5. PACLitaxel 175 mg/m2 IV over 3 hours, Day 1. Requires corticosteroid/antihistamine/H2 premedication (hypersensitivity). ISMP tall-man.

provenance.locator: Principles of Systemic Therapy (PN-D 4 of 5), TIP: PACLitaxel 175 mg/m2 IV over 3 hours on Day 1

drugs.name: ifosfamide
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v2.2026, PN-D 4 of 5. ifosfamide 1200 mg/m2 IV over 2 hours, Days 1 to 3, WITH MESNA PROTECTION (mandatory uroprotection against hemorrhagic cystitis). Monitor for ifosfamide encephalopathy. ISMP tall-man.

provenance.locator: Principles of Systemic Therapy (PN-D 4 of 5), TIP: Ifosfamide 1200 mg/m2 IV over 2 hours on Days 1 to 3

drugs.name: CISplatin
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v2.2026, PN-D 4 of 5. CISplatin 25 mg/m2 IV over 2 hours, Days 1 to 3. ISMP tall-man. No lifetime cumulative cap; requires IV pre/post hydration; monitor nephrotoxicity, ototoxicity, peripheral neuropathy.

provenance.locator: Principles of Systemic Therapy (PN-D 4 of 5), TIP: Cisplatin 25 mg/m2 IV over 2 hours on Days 1 to 3
